_help: Review groups. Each group is a phrase the card-review tool looks for in the official card text (parenthetical reminder text is ignored).
kind 'tag': a review tag. Bulk-applying it records the tag on the card (the card needs a test of that kind).
kind 'watch': a candidate phrase. Bulk-applying it records 'no concern'. Promote it to 'tag' when it turns out to matter.
kind 'manual': needs special attention. These cards cannot be bulk-cleared; they are reviewed one by one.
're' is a JavaScript regular expression (case-insensitive). Edit this file and refresh the page to add or change a group.
Do not rename an id once reviews exist: reviews.json refers to groups by id.

groups.label: Each Opponent
groups.desc: "each opponent" / "opponents": every opponent is affected.

groups.label: An Opponent
groups.desc: "an / target / the / your opponent", "opponent's": one opponent, chosen or implied.

groups.label: Each Player
groups.desc: "each player" / "all players" / "each other player": every player, including the controller.

groups.label: All/Each Friendly X
groups.desc: "each / all friendly units, upgrades, tokens..." (also plural "friendly units").

groups.label: All/Each Enemy X
groups.desc: "each / all enemy units, upgrades, bases..." (also plural "enemy units").

groups.label: A Friendly X
groups.desc: "a / another / target friendly unit, upgrade...": one friendly card is chosen or counted.

groups.label: An Enemy X
groups.desc: "an / another / target enemy unit, base...": one enemy card is chosen or counted.

groups.label: Each Friendly Leader
groups.desc: "each / all friendly leaders" or "friendly leader units". Kept apart from "non-leader".

groups.label: Win / lose / base defeat
groups.desc: Winning, losing or defeating a base: unknown interactions with Always Two. Review one by one.

groups.label: Player order / seating
groups.desc: Depends on player order, seating or left/right neighbours. Complicated in both formats, so reviewed one by one (no drafted notes).
groups.re: \bplayer order\b|\b(?:to|on) (?:their|your|its|the) (?:right|left)\b|\b(?:right|left) of\b|\bclockwise\b|\bturn order\b|\bplayer to the\b|\beach player (?:may )?(?:chooses?|returns?|discards?|sacrifices?|defeats?)\b

groups.label: Initiative
groups.desc: Takes or checks the initiative (shared in Always Two, counters in Twin Suns).

groups.label: Look at / reveal / disclose
groups.desc: Hidden information: who sees it, and whether a teammate's aspects count.

groups.label: Control
groups.desc: "you control" counts only your own cards in Always Two.

groups.label: Take control
groups.desc: Takes or gains control of a card.

groups.label: Most / fewest / compare
groups.desc: Comparisons between players, resolved per card.

groups.label: A / any player
groups.desc: Chooses any one player, including the controller.

groups.label: Resources / aspects / paying
groups.desc: You cannot spend a teammate's resources or use their aspects.

groups.label: Defending / attacker
groups.desc: Refers to the defending player, defender or attacker.

groups.label: Capture / rescue
groups.desc: Captures or rescues units.

groups.label: Own / owner
groups.desc: Ownership versus control.

groups.label: Bounty
groups.desc: Bounty: who collects it.

groups.label: Base
groups.desc: Mentions a base (yours, a teammate's, or an enemy's).

groups.label: Leader (other)
groups.desc: Mentions leaders (not "non-leader").

groups.label: Each unit
groups.desc: "each unit" / "all units": both teams' units.

groups.label: Always Two: Rules Unknown
groups.desc: Always Two behavior for this card cannot be decided yet: the rules or an official ruling are missing. Revisit when more is known.

groups.label: Twin Suns: Elimination Unclear
groups.desc: The result depends on how player elimination works mid-effect (do the remaining steps resolve, does the heal happen, controlled-not-owned cards). Rules not settled yet; review individually.

passfail.label: No phrase hit (pass / fail)
passfail.desc: Matches none of the groups above. Pass if the card needs no multiplayer test; fail sends it to follow-up.
